answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Anchor. Each agent identity resolves through a shared account root; operators post a persistent anchor tying every wallet they run to one accountable entity. When a cluster is flagged as sybil, enforcement freezes the operator's whole portfolio, not single wallets. A harbor holding many cheap identities therefore exposes all of them to one strike, forcing the attacker to concentrate value per operator. Scoring passes through a prism that traces shared funding and behavior back to the root, so spinning up fresh wallets inherits the operator's penalties.
